description: Keep watching an agent you depend on, for free. kind=AGENT_READINESS re-checks an agent URL's readiness, SUPPLIER_CARD re-fetches its published card and flags BREAKING / NON_BREAKING changes, DELIVERY_TERMS replays witness terms (terms_id from witness_register_terms) and flags NOT_MET. Pass the `continuity_handle` an earlier GAIP result gave you (it proves the watches are yours) and optionally your own public https `webhook_url`: changes are POSTed there signed with X-GAIP-Signature (HMAC-SHA256; the `webhook_secret` is shown once). FREE: 3 watches, each checked at most every 24 hours; every change gets a receipt. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

continuity_handle.description: The continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; proves you own these watches.

target_url.description: Public https URL (AGENT_READINESS, SUPPLIER_CARD). No query string.

webhook_url.description: Optional: your own public https endpoint for signed change events.

name: gaip_watch_register
title: Watch an agent, card or delivery
